senses.sense_definition: To cause fear, terror, or alarm in someone or something.

examples.text: Do not let the dog <w>scare</w> away the birds in the garden.

target_lang_translations.ru: Не позволяй собаке <w>распугать</w> птиц в саду.

target_lang_translations.pl: Nie pozwól, aby pies <w>spłoszył</w> ptaki w ogrodzie.

target_lang_definitions.it: Causare paura, terrore o allarme in qualcuno o qualcosa.

target_lang_definitions.tr: Birine veya bir şeye korku, dehşet veya endişe vermek.

senses.sense_definition: A sudden feeling of fear, shock, or alarm, usually not lasting long.

examples.text: You gave me a big <w>scare</w> when you jumped out from behind the door.
